place.name: Hlíðarfjall
place.description: Hlíðarfjall (Icelandic pronunciation: [ˈl̥iːðarˌfjatl̥] ) is a mountain and ski resort located around 6 km west of the Icelandic town Akureyri in Eyjafjörður. The mountain itself has an elevation of 1,200m, It is the second largest ski resort in Iceland and reaches a top elevation of 1,014m.
